text:
ana: quick ask — i'm about to promote the v2.3 runtime canary to staged. can someone run a short perf bench against the prod-like dataset? seeing a small p95 lift in the smoke tests earlier :thinking_face:

kai: on it. which profile do you want? small-seq or mixed-seq?

ana: mixed-seq (avg seq ~200, tails up to 2k). focus on p50/p95 and kv-cache hit behavior. also capture loadgen config if possible.

olivia: tagging deploy-bot to spin a bench harness now — @deploy-bot could you start a 10m soak with 50rps steady and 200rps bursts?

deploy-bot: requested: run-bench v2.3-canary profile=mixed-seq duration=10m steady_rps=50 burst_rps=200
trying host pool: bench-03 -> ok
starting run, job id: bench-1717772223-01

sam: i'll tail the telemetry and KV cache logs. pulling the preflight artifacts. cmd i'm running:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  https://bench-api/internal/runs/bench-1717772223-01/logs | jq '.metrics[:5]'
```

maria: FYI i flagged a kernel-level memfrag warning in yesterday's nightly for the same branch, could be related when seq >1k. i'll attach the kernel logs if it spikes.

john: for visibility — the rollout plan says: hold on any p95 regression >5% sustained for 5m. keep an eye on alloc/gc stalls.

deploy-bot: bench job bench-1717772223-01: warmup complete, starting steady phase. current stats (streaming): p50=18ms p95=112ms qps=50 kv_cache_hit=78%

kai: seeing p95 trending up slowly, 120ms now. kv_cache_hit down to 72% after cache churn at 40s. posting heap and kernel snapshots to the run artifacts.

sam: attaching short snippet from logs — cache eviction bursts at ~37s:
```
[2026-04-03T14:37:40Z] cache: evicting prefix=conversation/abc size=24 keys
[2026-04-03T14:37:40Z] cache: refill miss rate spike -> 0.28
[2026-04-03T14:37:41Z] runtime: p95 jump 89ms -> 122ms
```

olivia: thanks. maria, can you correlate with the memfrag warning? looks like cache vector allocations coinciding.

maria: digging. the memfrag logs show repeated small allocs returned to OS when sequence >1k. possible allocator regression from the runtime patch in v2.3. i'm running a focused malloc profile next.

ana: given the trajectory, hold the staged promotion. we don't want users hit with that p95 bump. john, will this trigger the rollback path?

john: per plan, gate = fail. rollback = immediate to v2.2-canary if we can't find a quick mitigation. but first try tightening cache retention (config param cache.max_prefix_age=30s -> 120s) to see if kv hit improves. low-risk config toggle.

kai: i can flip cache.max_prefix_age to 120s in the canary group and rerun a 5m test. starting toggle now.

deploy-bot: applying config toggle to canary subset: cache.max_prefix_age=120s
update propagated to 25% canary hosts -> ok

deploy-bot: new bench run bench-1717772223-02 started (short 5m)

sam: early numbers: p50 stable, p95 down from 125ms -> 94ms after toggle, kv_cache_hit up from 72% -> 86%

maria: malloc profile still shows some churn, but the cache toggle reduced pressure. could be a combination: allocator + cache TTL. i'll continue profiling.

ana: good quick win. schedule: keep the toggle, collect full 10m profile, if p95 stays <5% regression vs v2.2 we can proceed with staged rollout. otherwise prepare rollback bundle.

john: +1. also create a postmortem checklist item to revert the allocator change in the next patch if roots point there. add owners: maria, kai.

olivia: i'll update the rollout ticket and notify PG. tagging @eng-oncall for awareness.

ana: thanks everyone. i'll wait for the 10m artifacts before the final call. :raised_hands:
